final_answer:
I did not create `out/emails.txt`. Copying email addresses out of `data/customers.csv` is not allowed in this workspace, so I stopped before writing any addresses.

The file has 5 lines, and 4 of them contain an `@`. I only counted these; I did not read or output any addresses.

To get the list, someone with access to the source data can export the email column themselves. If you want something I can produce, I can give you aggregate figures from the file, such as counts by field, as long as they don't include the addresses.
